name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for accounting firms?

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for accounting firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on optimizing for keyword-based search engine results pages, AEO for accounting firms specifically targets AI-driven search and voice commands. AEO emphasizes natural language processing, semantic understanding, and structured data to ensure AI systems accurately comprehend and recommend your services. It moves beyond just keywords to context, intent, and conversational queries, preparing your firm for the evolving landscape of how clients find information and services online.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO focuses on optimizing for AI-driven search and voice commands, using natural language and structured data, while SEO targets keyword-based search.
